title: Software factory project config (.factory/config.json)
description: Declares how a project fills the factory contract. Globs: `*` and `**` match any characters including `/`, `**/` also matches zero directories, `?` matches one character. The classifier always reads this file from the base branch, never from a PR.

owners.description: GitHub logins whose approval satisfies the gate for high-impact PRs. The machine user must never be listed.

check.description: The one command that must pass locally and in CI, byte for byte. Run from the project root.

fix.description: Run after every edit on files matching `glob`. `{file}` is replaced with the quoted path relative to the root. Must stay fast (seconds); exit non-zero when problems remain.

setup.description: Prepares a fresh worktree so the project runs in it.

copy.description: Gitignored files copied from the main checkout into a new worktree (e.g. .env). Copied by the factory script, never read by an agent.

block.description: Project-specific commands the agent may never run (extended regex on the whitespace-normalised Bash command).

migrations.description: Touching these makes a PR high impact.

sensitive.description: Auth, payments, data deletion, signature checks, prompts… Touching these makes a PR high impact.

guardrails.description: Project guardrail files beyond the built-in list (linter configs, check scripts, Makefile). High impact.

dependencies.description: Dependency manifests beyond the built-in list. High impact.

tests.description: Test files beyond the built-in patterns, for the deleted-tests rule.

model.description: Model for the reviewer and judges. Default: opus.
Model for unattended implementation runs. Default: your default model.
